name: fuse_rank_local_prepare_stage
hypothesis: Fusing local target extraction, shifted exponentiation, and denominator accumulation into one row kernel reduces PyTorch reduction/index/elementwise launch overhead while retaining the required MAX, SUM(predicted), and SUM(denominator) ordering.
assumptions: global_max is the result of the real MAX all-reduce
exp_logits is consumed after the real denominator SUM all-reduce
caller supplies the current CUDA stream
risks: one-thread-per-row loops may underutilize very large local vocabularies
expf and serial accumulation can differ slightly from framework reduction order
